In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-82°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-70°. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra.
